label: NORMAL
notes: Rows combine port-level OpenFlow monitoring samples with flow-level measurements. Receiver throughput and UDP packet loss come from iperf3 when available. Ping delay is measured after the traffic scenario and repeated across that flow's rows; it is not a per-row latency measurement. Queue length and link status are not measured and are recorded as -1. Do not treat repeated flow measurements as independent observations. Existing measured values were preserved.

feature_availability.utilization_pct: Measured from Ryu OpenFlow port statistics
feature_availability.delay_ms: Post-scenario ping average repeated across rows
feature_availability.packet_loss_pct: Receiver-side iperf3 loss when available; otherwise ping loss
